{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Use Maven as the build tool for Spring XD projects.",
    "Use Java 8 as the base Java version, with support for Java Lambdas in the Spark Streaming processor (U5).",
    "Implement the Spark Streaming data processor as a new module within the Spring XD plugin architecture.",
    "For Windows build support (U3), assume native Windows build environment (e.g., MSYS2, Git Bash) rather than Cygwin.",
    "For Windows acceptance testing (U4), provision an EC2 Windows instance using a pre-configured AMI and run tests via Jenkins CI.",
    "Backport Kafka XD changes to the Spring Integration Kafka (SI Kafka) project before upgrading to the GA release (U7).",
    "Upgrade to the SHDP (Spring Hadoop Distribution) GA release by updating dependency versions and resolving any API changes (U8).",
    "Reference guide PDF generation uses DocBook or AsciiDoc toolchain; copyright update (U6) requires a single text change."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The source code and documentation repositories are accessible and up-to-date.",
    "The development team has prior experience with Spring XD, Spring Integration, and related frameworks.",
    "All dependencies (Maven, Java, Gradle, etc.) are available for the development environment.",
    "The existing test infrastructure (unit, integration, acceptance) is in place and can be extended.",
    "The CI system (e.g., Jenkins) is already configured and can be modified for Windows builds.",
    "The Pig sample (U2) will be a simple example script demonstrating integration with Spring XD.",
    "The Spark Streaming processor (U5) will support at least one use case (e.g., word count) for demonstration.",
    "Backporting Kafka changes (U7) requires merging code from the feature branch to the SI Kafka master branch before upgrading.",
    "The SHDP upgrade (U8) is a minor version change with backward-compatible API for the most part.",
    "All effort estimates include time for unit testing, integration testing, and documentation updates where applicable."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Migration from XD 1.0 to 1.1 and port custom modules (U1)",
      "activity_description": "Analyze changes between Spring XD 1.0 and 1.1, update codebase to match new APIs, port existing custom modules to be compatible, and verify through testing.",
      "most_likely_effort": 15
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Create Pig script/job sample (U2)",
      "activity_description": "Develop a sample Pig script and Spring XD job configuration that demonstrates integration of Pig jobs with XD, including documentation and testing.",
      "most_likely_effort": 2
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Build XD on Windows machine (U3)",
      "activity_description": "Adapt build scripts (Maven, shell scripts) to work on Windows, resolve path and permission issues, and verify that the full build succeeds on a Windows environment.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Run acceptance tests on Windows with CI (U4)",
      "activity_description": "Provision an EC2 Windows image, configure it with necessary tools, run the acceptance test suite, and set up a CI build (e.g., Jenkins) to execute tests automatically.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Build Spark Streaming data processor (U5)",
      "activity_description": "Design and implement a new data processor module for Spark Streaming in Spring XD, using Java, Java Lambdas, and Scala; include unit and integration tests, and provide a sample demonstration.",
      "most_likely_effort": 20
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Update copyright message in reference guide PDF (U6)",
      "activity_description": "Locate the copyright text in the documentation source, change the year from 2014 to 2015, regenerate the PDF, and verify correctness.",
      "most_likely_effort": 0.5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Upgrade to Kafka SI GA release (U7)",
      "activity_description": "Backport existing Spring XD Kafka changes to the Spring Integration Kafka project, then upgrade the dependency to the GA release version, resolving any API incompatibilities and testing.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Upgrade to SHDP GA release (U8)",
      "activity_description": "Update Spring XD dependency on Spring Hadoop (SHDP) to the GA release version, adapt code if necessary, and run tests to ensure compatibility.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 58.5
  }
}

5. Spark Streaming processor (U5) - implement data processor for Spark Streaming using Java and Scala. This includes design, implementation, unit tests.
6. Update copyright (U6) - modify PDF generation, update year.
7. Kafka upgrade (U7) - upgrade to Kafka SI GA, backport changes.
8. SHDP upgrade (U8) - upgrade to SHDP GA.

But we should combine related activities? The WBS should be activities that are part of delivering the increment. Each user story is a requirement. We can treat each as an activity or break further. Since effort estimates need single number per activity, we can define activities per user story. However, some may be broken into sub-activities. We assume Spring XD is Maven-based. We assume the team has existing knowledge. We'll assume each activity includes testing.

We'll create activities with IDs like A1, A2, etc.

Let's estimate effort in workdays. Typical developer day is 8 hours. We'll be conservative.

U4: Windows acceptance test and CI. Setting up EC2, writing scripts, CI config. Estimate: 5 days.
U5: Spark Streaming processor. This is a new feature. Need to implement a new data processor module, integrate with XD, write tests, possibly examples. Estimate: 20 days (design, coding, unit tests, integration tests).
U6: Copyright update. Trivial: 0.5 day.
U7: Kafka upgrade. Upgrade dependency, backport changes. Might be moderate. Estimate: 8 days.
U8: SHDP upgrade. Similar to Kafka. Estimate: 5 days.

Total: 15+2+3+5+20+0.5+8+5 = 58.5 days. We can round to 59? But better keep 58.5. Or we can adjust. Since it's effort, we can express fractions. We'll keep 0.5 for U6.

- Use Java 8 with Lambdas for Spark (U5).
- Use existing Spring XD plugin architecture for Spark processor.
- For Windows, use Cygwin or native? Assume native.
- For CI, use Jenkins? Assume.
- Backporting Kafka changes: assume there is a branch.

Also assumptions: We have full access to source code and documentation. We assume team has experience.
